pipelines.title: Lewis and Clark expedition journals
pipelines.description: The journals three men kept on the expedition of 1804–1806, segmented into dated entries and passages, with observations extracted against the exact characters they came from.
licenses: Public domain in the United States
sources: The Journals of Lewis and Clark
Gass's Journal of the Lewis and Clark Expedition

stages.label: Acquire
stages.summary: Two public-domain editions: Project Gutenberg 8419 and the 1904 Hosmer edition of Gass, from the Internet Archive.

stages.label: Parse
stages.summary: Dated journal entries, one parser per edition's heading style.

stages.label: Segment
stages.summary: Entries cut into passages that carry their character offsets.

stages.label: Extract
stages.summary: Observations tied to the exact characters they came from, in the segments the research scopes name.

stages.label: Reference
stages.summary: Library of Congress items reviewed for item-level rights.

windows.title: The Great Falls Portage — June and July 1805
Lemhi Pass and the Shoshone — August 1805
Fort Clatsop Winter — December 1805 to March 1806

known_limitations: Gass is an OCR transcription of a 1904 edition; his entries carry the editor's spelling, not the manuscript's.
Only the segments listed in data/reference/research_scopes.json have had observations extracted; the rest of the corpus is loaded but unextracted.
The expedition's own maps and photographs of the route are held by other institutions; archive references come from the Library of Congress.

pipelines.title: SourceCut Odyssey
pipelines.description: An evidence-backed research environment for Homer's Odyssey, its translations, narrative structure, geography, and visual reception.

stages.label: Acquire
stages.summary: Perseus TEI at a pinned revision: the Greek, Murray's translation, and Butler's, under CC BY-SA.

stages.label: Parse
stages.summary: Lines addressed by book and line, not by date — the poem has no calendar.

stages.label: Segment
stages.summary: Citable passages across the three versions.

stages.label: Extract
stages.summary: Annotation layers rather than observations: repeated formulae, narrative events in both reading and story order, and named places. The reviewed claim layer has not been populated.

stages.label: Reference
stages.summary: Route proposals are kept as competing hypotheses with disputed coordinates, never as one line on a map.

windows.title: The poem, addressed by book and line

known_limitations: Component-level TEI header rights review is required before public launch.
Text content and source hashes are populated by the E2 ingestion pipeline.
No modern copyrighted translations are included.
